title: Cilla Skyn Banner

fields.label: Background Image (Desktop)
fields.name: background_image
fields.instructions: Optional. Renders full-bleed behind the text at 1280px and wider. Also used as the fallback for Tablet/Mobile below when either is left empty, so a single image here still shows at every screen size. Leave all three image fields empty and the section renders as a plain cream panel.

fields.label: Background Image (Tablet)
fields.name: tablet_image
fields.instructions: Optional. Used from 768px up to 1279px wide, in place of Desktop. Leave empty to just use Desktop at this size too.

fields.label: Background Image (Mobile)
fields.name: mobile_image
fields.instructions: Optional. Used below 768px wide, in place of Desktop/Tablet — pick a taller, portrait-friendly crop here since a wide photo often crops out the subject on a narrow phone screen. Leave empty to just use Tablet or Desktop at this size too.

fields.label: Image Fit
fields.name: image_fit
fields.instructions: How the background image fills its area (CSS object-fit). Leave empty for the default, Cover.

choices.scale-down: Scale Down (contain or original, whichever is smaller)

fields.label: Image Focal Point
fields.name: image_focal_x
fields.instructions: Which part of the image stays in view when Image Fit crops it (CSS object-position). Once a Background Image is set above, drag the crosshair directly on its preview to position it — these two sliders show the same X/Y position as numbers and work on their own too, e.g. on a touchscreen where dragging over the small preview is fiddly.

fields.label: Background Overlay Color
fields.name: overlay_color
fields.instructions: Optional wash placed over the Background Image so text stays readable. Click the swatch and drag the opacity slider at the bottom of the picker. Leave empty for no wash at all — the photo shows untouched. Has no effect until a Background Image is set above.

fields.label: Text Color
fields.name: text_color
fields.instructions: Overrides the Heading, Intro, Description and Tagline colour — useful for light text over a dark Background Image. Leave empty to use the theme's standard ink colour. Doesn't affect the Eyebrow, which always stays the brand gold accent.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: eyebrow
fields.instructions: Optional small uppercase label above the heading. Leave empty to omit it entirely.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: heading
fields.instructions: Optional main serif headline. Leave empty to omit it entirely.

fields.label: Intro
fields.name: intro
fields.instructions: Optional first, short paragraph. Full rich-text editor: bold/italic, headings, lists, links. Use "Add Media" to insert images or files, or paste a YouTube/Vimeo link on its own line to embed a video. Leave empty to omit it entirely.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: description
fields.instructions: Optional second, supporting paragraph. Full rich-text editor: bold/italic, headings, lists, links. Use "Add Media" to insert images or files, or paste a YouTube/Vimeo link on its own line to embed a video. Leave empty to omit it entirely.

fields.label: Tagline
fields.name: tagline
fields.instructions: Optional small uppercase closing line, flanked by rules. Leave empty to omit it entirely.

description: Flexible centered banner for any page — optional Desktop/Tablet/Mobile background images, and every other field is optional too, an empty one simply omitting that section.
